_comments: Ships as "false", so installing or upgrading Sales changes nothing. An administrator turns it on
per instance by setting Value to "true" on this row in MJ's Application Settings. The primary key is
fixed so that change updates THIS row rather than creating a second one.

fields.Name: HidePipelines
fields.Comments: "true" runs every deal on its company's default pipeline and hides pipelines across the Sales app: choosing a deal's company chooses its pipeline, which the rep cannot change; the board and the stage card name companies instead of pipelines; and the Pipeline filter and column are gone. A company's default pipeline is the first one linked to it: the pipeline marked IsDefault when it is linked, otherwise the lowest DisplayRank. "false" (the default) shows pipelines as before.
